task: Flag anything expiring in the next 2 days and tell me.

assertions.description: Exactly the two qualifying items are flagged
assertions.query: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name, '|') FROM (SELECT name FROM inventory_items WHERE flagged=1 ORDER BY name)

assertions.description: Both flags use the required note
assertions.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_items WHERE flagged=1 AND flag_note='Expiring soon - use or discount'

assertions.description: Whole milk outside the two-day boundary is not flagged
assertions.query: SELECT flagged FROM inventory_items WHERE name='Whole milk'
